name: contextPack

versions.rationale: Fills sections in priority order (unit, notes, tests, dependencies, callers, earlier rationale) until the token budget is spent and counts what it cut. Code and signatures are listed as missing because they need the indexer's spans (#19); issue lookup stays a stub until the issue-tracker integration.

docs: Builds a context pack for a unit or task, filling sections in priority order within a token budget.
